parts.answer: In HN-204, the treatment-emergent adverse event nausea occurred in 12.7% of the AX-17 group and 6.0% of the Control group, and it was not serious. In HN-402, nausea occurred in 14.1% of the AX-17 group and 6.0% of the Control group, and it was not serious. The treatment % for nausea in HN-402 was +1.4 points higher than in HN-204, while the control % remained the same with a +0.0 points difference. Nausea was the highest treatment % in both HN-204 (12.7%) and HN-402 (14.1%).
